worldcombat.skill.silverwind.summary: Shake a broad fan of silver scales forward: foes inside the sector are cut once and the scales drift down and fade; a returning pinch of scales may raise all the user's stats by one stage. Dense form is shorter, narrower and heavier; loose form reaches farther and wider and casts faster.
worldcombat.skill.silverwind.use.0: Cut several foes standing side by side at once
worldcombat.skill.silverwind.use.1: Poke from a little farther out as an opener
worldcombat.skill.silverwind.use.2: Cover blocks the fan entirely, so position behind it matters
worldcombat.skill.silverwind.description: The scale fan deals %1$s special damage and reaches %2$s blocks.
The fan spans %1$s degrees, and the scales hang for %2$s seconds before settling — the window to step out of the sector.
It has a %1$s chance to raise all the user's stats by %2$s stage(s).
About %1$s scales fill the fan; dense form is currently %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.silverwind.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.silverwind.growth.0: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s and the fan reaches %3$s blocks.
On: fan length ×0.82, angle ×0.8, power ×1.1 and +0.05 surge chance, but a longer cooldown — for cutting one named direction harder. Off (loose form, default): reaches farther and wider and casts faster, for sweeping a small side-by-side group.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; larger values sweep at more distant targets.
On: a target with other foes within 3 blocks ranks higher, since one fan can cut several at once. Off: every target ranks the same.
world_combat.move.silverwind.text.miss: The scales scatter on empty air
